subject: cavescene
name: 山洞
label: 藤叶山洞
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One natural cave entrance among three large connected boulders, an uneven arch, a small hanging vine with four leaves and a short path into the opening.
Pure black OUTLINE ONLY, empty white interiors. Absolutely no solid dark fill, gray wash or hatching. Only the requested forms, no extra shrubs, grass, pebbles or texture. Smooth connected contours. Whole composition fits comfortably inside 10 percent clear margins. Cave opening remains pure white inside, no shaded darkness.
